scopes.orders:read: See your orders, returns, and bookings. Needed to track an order or find one to change
scopes.orders:write: Exchange or return items, and change bookings. Needed for any change to an order
scopes.addresses: See and change your saved shipping addresses. Not needed to enter an address at checkout
scopes.poppy:browser-sign-in: Use the website signed in, with the other access you approve
